faq_section.description: Find answers to common VicastCam questions below. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our team.

questions.question: Which platforms can I stream to with VicastCam?
questions.answer: VicastCam supports streaming to major platforms like YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Facebook Live, and Instagram.

questions.question: Does VicastCam's background removal require a green screen?
questions.answer: No. VicastCam uses AI-powered background removal, so you can replace your background in real time without a green screen.

questions.question: Can I use VicastCam on my phone?
questions.answer: Yes. VicastCam is available on iOS and Android, and all professional features are available on mobile.

questions.question: How reliable is VicastCam?
questions.answer: VicastCam offers 99.9% stability, supporting streamers worldwide with 24/7 uninterrupted streaming.

questions.question: Does VicastCam support multi-camera streaming?
questions.answer: Yes. You can seamlessly switch between multiple cameras during a live stream to achieve a professional production.
